Avery L: Dropping a compact customer-facing runbook for go-live warming + renewal-signal watch list. Keep this to copy/paste snippets for AEs.
Noah P: Love it. Make the snippets as "paste-and-run" as possible.
Renee M: I'll field-test during the demo next week. Quick ask: include a lightweight streaming validation that product folks can run.
Avery L: Agreed. Runbook (one-screen):
- Step 1: Tenant prefill (top N user prompts) to populate KV cache and cold-key embeddings
- Step 2: Start warm instances (reserve minimal pool = concurrency_estimate * 0.4)
- Step 3: Warm shared model KV caches (prefix cache + context embeddings)
- Step 4: Streaming smoke: full stream + truncated-chunk test
- Step 5: Monitor first-24h signals and tag renewal-risk if triggered

Avery L: Paste-ready prefill (curl):
```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/prefill" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant":"tenant_acme","prompts":["onboarding_welcome","default_instructions"],"limit":50}'
```
Noah P: Lightweight streaming check (python SSE client). Good for PMs to run locally:
```python
# streaming_check.py
import requests
from sseclient import SSEClient
resp = requests.post(
  'https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=redwood-small',
  headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + TOKEN},
  json={'input':'hello','max_tokens':64},
  stream=True)
for event in SSEClient(resp):
    print(event.data)
```
Renee M: Client retry guidance (short): exponential backoff + full jitter, max 3 retries, surface to async queue after 20s cumulative latency.
Avery L: Frontend SDK suggestion: retry=3, base_ms=200, cap_ms=20_000, jitter=true. Also prefer incremental streaming ack so UI updates per chunk.
Noah P: Alerting snippets for SRE/AE to copy into monitoring: (pseudo-yaml)
```yaml
- alert: TenantHighErrors
  expr: sum(rate(http_errors_total{tenant="tenant_acme"}[5m])) > 5
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    runbook: https://redwood.example/runbooks/tenant-errors
- alert: StreamingDropRate
  expr: increase(stream_chunk_misses_total{tenant="tenant_acme"}[15m]) > 10
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: critical
```
Avery L: Renewal-risk quick list (to surface to AEs automatically):
- sustained >3% 5xx over baseline in first 72h
- >=15% drop in completion rate vs baseline
- repeated 429 spikes correlated with burst events
- negative feedback in go-live survey (NPS <= 4)
Tag account: `cs:renewal-risk` and schedule 15-min touch.
Renee M: Feedback capture fields for short form: immediate latency (p50/p95 perceived), missing/chopped stream chunks, accuracy drop after quantization, onboarding clarity (1-5), free text. Link: https://forms.redwood.example/go-live-quick
Noah P: Ops recommendation: if warm_pool_util < 0.7 => trigger burst nodes + send AE slack ping. Also fallback: route non-critical UX to smaller model to keep latency SLOs.
Avery L: Quick CLI health checks for AEs/ops: `redwoodctl tenant inspect --tenant tenant_acme --fields warm_pool_util,cache_hits,stream_errors`
Renee M: Who's volunteering to run the first streaming smoke for BetaCorp on Thursday 09:30 PT?
Noah P: I can do it and will post results here.
Ops Bot: prefill-job/tenant_acme started by @Noah P — job id jf-84k2 — ETA ~2m.
